prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 6 tests with 2 wins, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.3% after noise correction across 4 tests with 1 win, though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, averaging +0.1% after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_flow; adoption, new_screen; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, showing no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +2.9% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.4% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +1.3% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.2% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Pet account restoration guarantee hint: Displays a clear hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets will automatically re-sync to their account upon log in. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Carousel layout for pick friend selection: Redesigns the pet pick screen into a high-visibility carousel view to make browsing starter pets smoother. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate at 60.9% and high median completion time (89s).)
2: [home, wait_info] Estimated pet creation timer on waiting screen: Displays a dynamic time estimate badge on the pet generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time of 2336s, causing user frustration and drop-off.)
3: [finish, redesign] Split view layout for desktop home intro: Redesigns the final home intro step into a split-layout presentation highlighting pet desktop positioning and controls. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Account privacy and data control badge: Adds a subtle security badge reassuring users about privacy, account deletion, and data control rights on sign in. (why: 4 support requests concerned account deletion and personal data management.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive companion badge confirmation flow: Introduces an official verified badge component on the adoption certificate step to establish clear ownership. (why: Custom pet creation confusion and low adoption conversion (60.9%) require clearer completion confirmation.)
6: [adoption, copy] Photo upload formatting guidance headline: Updates headline copy on photo upload to instruct users on submitting bright, clear frontal photos. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pets.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Compact layout for story screen: Switches the initial story intro screen layout to compact mode so users transition quickly to path choice. (why: Users take a long average time (mean 514s) to navigate path choice.)
8: [home, wait_info] Background pet finish notification toggle: Enables desktop desktop notification options when pet generation finishes. (why: The waiting step mean time is high (2336s), leading users to tab away or close the app before completion.)
